guide:
Prins prints notes on a 312x216 black and white pixel grid. Origin is top-left.
Start with draw_poster: it gives the best design for the fewest words. Use the other draw_* tools for details it can't do, then print_note or send_to_friend. draw_batch is the cheapest way to do several steps.
x,y,w,h default to the whole grid. ink is black, white, invert, or a pattern name (dots:6, gray:30).
For a brand logo use draw_logo first. For anything else use draw_svg (path data), draw_image (URL, path, base64) or draw_pixels. Any design is possible.
preview shows the note. Text auto-sizes to fit its box when size is 0.
look_guide: block=loud statement; alarm=urgent, broken, blocked; relief=one calm word; monument=a win, a launch; ransom=playful nag, under 5 words; numeral=countdown, key number; collide=appointment at a time; picture=a thing or creature; engraving=night, quiet, elegant; stage=event, show; post=greeting, thanks, birthday; ticket=meeting, trip: items KEY: VALUE; rain=weather, trend: data, items label it; ridges=a total: big, data; transit=merge, route: items name lines; cover=start of a day; list=several items; quote=sentences, poem

tools.name: draw_poster
tools.description: Designs a whole note from its meaning: layout, type and shading. Never invent facts.

look.description: omit to auto-choose. block=loud statement; alarm=urgent, broken, blocked; relief=one calm word; monument=a win, a launch; ransom=playful nag, under 5 words; numeral=countdown, key number; collide=appointment at a time; picture=a thing or creature; engraving=night, quiet, elegant; stage=event, show; post=greeting, thanks, birthday; ticket=meeting, trip: items KEY: VALUE; rain=weather, trend: data, items label it; ridges=a total: big, data; transit=merge, route: items name lines; cover=start of a day; list=several items; quote=sentences, poem

tools.name: compare_looks
tools.description: See content in the looks that suit it, as one numbered image. Takes draw_poster's fields, plus n. Changes nothing.

tools.name: draw_batch
tools.description: Run many ops in one call. Each op is {op:poster|text|figure|pattern|frame|shape|image|svg|logo|pixels|formula|qr|transform|repeat|scatter|clear, ...same args as its draw_ tool}. repeat: {n,dx,dy,ops}. scatter: {n,seed,x,y,w,h,ops}.

tools.name: draw_text
tools.description: Text. size 0 fits the box. align l|c|r, valign t|m|b.

tools.name: draw_figure
tools.description: A figure (see catalog figures), or any emoji as name emoji:🎂.

tools.name: draw_pattern
tools.description: Fill a box with a pattern (see catalog patterns). name:size sets scale, gray:N a flat tone. shape ellipse for a round fill.

tools.name: draw_frame
tools.description: A border (see catalog frames). Any figure name also repeats around the edge.

tools.name: draw_shape
tools.description: kind: rect, rrect (r), ellipse, line, curve, polygon (pts [[x,y],..]), arc, pie, chord (a0,a1 degrees). fill false for outline, lw line width.

tools.name: draw_logo
tools.description: A brand logo by name (spotify, nike...), from Simple Icons.

tools.name: draw_svg
tools.description: Any vector. d: SVG path data with vb viewBox (default 0 0 24 24), or svg: full markup, or src: SVG URL or path.

tools.name: draw_image
tools.description: Any image, dithered to one bit. src: URL, file path, or base64. fit contain|cover|stretch. dither atkinson|floyd|bayer|halftone|threshold.

tools.name: draw_pixels
tools.description: Exact pixels. rows: strings where . is off and anything else on, with scale. Or b64: packed bits (1 = black) with w.

tools.name: draw_formula
tools.description: Per-pixel math: true paints. Vars x,y,u,v(0-1),r,a(polar),W,H. Funcs sin,cos,tan,atan2,sqrt,abs,floor,hypot,min,max,noise,pow. Example: sin(r/6+a*3)>0

tools.name: draw_qr
tools.description: A QR code for s.

tools.name: transform
tools.description: Change a region. kind: invert, flip-h, flip-v, rotate (deg), mirror-h, mirror-v, shift (dx,dy), pixelate (size), outline.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Names. kind: looks, figures, patterns, frames, fonts, dithers, ops, system_fonts. Omit for most.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo n steps.

tools.name: clear
tools.description: A blank note.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: The note as an image.

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Save the current note under a name.

tools.name: load_design
tools.description: Draw a saved design.

tools.name: print_note
tools.description: Print the current note on the user's Prins. text makes a plain note. title labels it.

tools.name: list_friends
tools.description: Friends, and who accepts notes.

tools.name: send_to_friend
tools.description: Send the current note to a friend's Prins, which waits for their button. text makes a plain note.
